answer: A paired-receipt bond on the dune stops fakes: each stakes 70 credits and takes a partner. Each files a key-signed ember receipt for its partner; the auditor matches pairs. The oasis registry takes one receipt per key; a lone receipt burns both. Filings cost 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes owe 3,037,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented ember receipts name their owner, so one key in two pairs burns both; honest agents pay 40 once and keep theirs.
